# Third-party scripts

Reserved for **future** externally authored scripts when their redistribution is permitted, with original creator/source and license information alongside each project.

The maintainer has said [VisionHub.lua](../VisionHub.lua) and [VisionHubAutoFarm.lua](../VisionHubAutoFarm.lua) are third-party, but they remain at their original root paths so existing URLs do not break. Their original attribution details still need confirmation in [CREDITS.md](../docs/CREDITS.md).

Hosting a script here does not imply authorship, endorsement, or permission to redistribute it.
